nodes.label: Competitive Capture Programme Initiative
nodes.rationale: To capture enquiries lost to The London Funeral Singers, LCS needed a sourced, verifiable comparison page built on three checkable differences: price (24-38% cheaper inc. VAT), repertoire allowance (up to three hymns vs their one performance piece), and how the ensemble is assembled (small hand-picked team under a named Artistic Director vs their 'over 150 auditioned singers' claim). Point 3 required repairing the site first -- removing false 'VAT-registered' claims from 6 B2B pages and a near-verbatim-competitor '150+ singers' claim from 13 places -- before the comparison's central claim could be made honestly. A new build-gated validator (validate_competitor_claims.py) and its test are the repo's first test, so a claims-integrity check couldn't silently pass vacuously.
